mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as reduced labor market friction enhances corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not fall below 6.0% within the 3-month window, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST decreases while the other rises, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), elevated interest rates reduce discount rates on corporate debt, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not exhibit a sustained upward trend over the 20-day window, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both INDPRO and RSAFS increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either INDPRO or RSAFS decreases while the other rises, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100, signaling robust manufacturing activity, this triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as supply chain strength boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 100.0 within the next trading period, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in employment (PAYEMS) reflects labor market strength, enhancing corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth stalls or plateaus over the 60-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase marked by rising GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST), these dual demand indicators drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise during the recovery phase, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
